lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
መስቀል መድኃኒትና ኃይሊ እግዚ አብሔር/2/
ብማኅሌት መኣዲ ብመዝሙር ይወደስ/2/
[[/chorus]]

ወጺኡ መስቀልና ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር
ብርሃን ተመሊኡ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ጎይታ ዝቐደሶ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ብወርቃዊ ደሙ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]እሰይ/3/ነቕርብ ዕልልታ[[/highlight]]
መስቀል ተረኺቡ ፍረ ጎልጎታ

ኣምላኽና ናትና በደል ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር
ዝተሰከመሉ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ዝኸበረ ደሙ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
በዓሉ ዘፍሰሰሉ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
መስቀለ ክርስቶስ ተኣምር ሰሪሑ
ድውያነ ስጋ ብኃይሉ ፈዊሱ

መለለዪ መንነት ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር
ጸላኢ መሕፈሪ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ምርኩስ ክርስቲያን [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ሰይጣን መባረሪ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ዘደንቕ ማሕተምና ፍሉይ ውህብቶና
ተቐሪጽካ ኢኻ ኣብ ፅላት ልብና

ኣርማ ክርስቲያን ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር
ጸጋ ተመሊኡ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ምስክር ድሕነት’ዩ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ዓለም ኣጋዊሑ [[highlight]]ኃይሊ እግዚአብሔር[[/highlight]]
ንዓና እንኣምን ምልክት ድሕነትና
መስቀል ኃይልና እዩ ኣምላኽ ዝሃበና
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Mesqel medhanitna hayli ʾigzi ʾabher/2/
Bimahlet meʾadi bimezmur yiwedes/2/
[[/chorus]]

Wetsiʾu mesqelna hayli Egziabher
Birhan temeliʾu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Goyta ziqhedeso [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Biwerqawi demu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ʾIsey/3/neqhrib ʿillita[[/highlight]]
Mesqel terekhibu fre Golgota

ʾAmlakhna natna bedel hayli Egziabher
Zitesekemelu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Zikhebere demu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Beʿalu zefseselu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Mesqele Kristos teʾamr serihu
Diwyane siga bihaylu fewisu

Meleleyi mennet hayli Egziabher
Tselaʾi mehferi [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Mirkus kirsitiyan [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Seyt'an mebareri [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Zedenqh mahtemna filuy wihbitona
Teqheritska ʾikha ʾab tsilat libna

ʾArma kirsitiyan hayli Egziabher
Tsega temeliʾu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Miskir dihnet’yu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
ʿAlem ʾagawihu [[highlight]]hayli Egziabher[[/highlight]]
Niʿana ʾinʾamn milkit dihnetna
Mesqel haylina ʾiyu ʾamlakh zihabena
